biggest_catch: You request payment yourself after approval — nothing is automatic, and payment requests only process on business days.
catches: Payment is not automatic: you must request it in the app after approval.
Approved projects process up to 6 days after upload; requests before 5 PM ET Mon-Fri pay next business day (no weekend/holiday processing).
Pay via direct deposit or prepaid debit card through partner Openforce — bank/payment setup required.
GPS must stay on during visits; projects vary by location and availability.

steps: Download the free Survey Merchandiser app and register
Browse available projects and claim ones with listed pay
Complete the in-store visit with location services on
Wait for approval (up to 6 days from upload)
Request payment in the app; paid next business day if requested before 5 PM ET Mon-Fri
timing: Approved projects processed for payment up to 6 days after upload; once approved, request payment anytime — requests before 5 PM ET Mon-Fri paid next business day. Direct deposit or prepaid debit card via Openforce.
maximize: Every project lists its pay upfront — only take ones that beat your hourly bar. Upload early on a weekday and request payment before 5 PM ET to get paid the next business day.
